_help: Edit names, descriptions, categories, prices, unlock levels and ingredients here, then restart the server. Do NOT change commodity 'code' or tier 'key' values in a running game (they are the item ids). Category names must match those used by contacts and events (Herbal, Stimulant, Crystal, Opioid-class, Hallucinogen-class, Designer) or those links stop working.
